sentence_2_it: Essere neri è meglio di essere gay. Se sei nato nero, almeno non devi pensare come dirlo a tua madre.
sentence_2_en: To be black is better than to be gay. If you were born black, at least you don't have to think about how to tell your mother about this.
sentence_3_it: Non dovreste usare la parola gay come insulto.
sentence_3_en: You shouldn't use the word gay as an insult.
